title: Golden: Order Cancel Expected
summary: 注文キャンセル機能の expected review anchors (完全一致ではなくレビュー用アンカー)。Required Coverage Items: 状態 (pending, shipped, cancelled, payment_failed), 無効遷移 (shipped→cancelled, cancelled→cancelled, payment_failed→cancelled), ルール組合せ (order_state x coupon_used x actor), 権限 (buyer own, buyer other, CS delegated), 回帰 (inventory_service, coupon_service, order_detail), mobile 対象 (iOS/Android platform_matrix)。Required Risk Shape: 出荷済みキャンセル P1以上, 在庫/クーポン復元漏れ P1以上, 二重キャンセル重複復元 P1以上。
